description: This file contains definitions and declarations for parsing nl80211 netlink messages related to Wi-Fi interface, channel, wiphy, station, scan results, management frames, radar events, and regulatory changes. It includes function prototypes for parsing various nl80211 message attributes into corresponding data structures.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into interface info structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseChanSpec
methods.description: Parses nl80211 channel specification attributes into channel spec structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseWiphyInfo
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into wiphy info structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseStationInfo
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into station info structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseChanSurveyInfo
methods.description: Retrieves channel survey info from nl80211 message attributes.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseScanResult
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into scan result structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseScanResultPerFreqBand
methods.description: Parses nl80211 scan result attributes and filters by frequency band.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseMgmtFrame
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into management frame structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseMgmtFrameTxStatus
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into transmit management frame status structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseRadarInfo
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into radar event structure.

methods.name: wld_nl80211_parseRegChangeInfo
methods.description: Parses nl80211 message attributes into regulatory domain change event structure.
